svg.text: Algorithmic Uprising open world · annotated top-down layout · CONCEPT v1 — PROPOSED, not the deployed build

Zero's command room · Fony's comms lab · bunks · kitchen

public front · retro cabinets · neighborhood hangout
ARCADE DOORS (building entrance, inside the yard)
★ MAIN GATE — the ONLY way in/out
Rooftop solar (via internal roof stair only)
• ONE external entrance: Main Gate, SE on Rust Ave.
No openings on N, E or W walls.
• Arcade doors + staff-only door are building doors,
• Skate loop never leaves the yard; passes docks,
roof stair, drainage bowl, stair set, gate yard.
• Warm salvaged West/inside vs cold neon East.
Cyan = 2+ links per standard section (approx. 200 m each).
Gold = HQ's only link (Main Gate → Rust Ave).
